import { URI } from '../model/uri';
import { CharCode } from '../common/charCode';
import { isNone } from './core';

/**
 * POSIX path operations re-implemented locally so `@foam/core` runs in both
 * Node and browser contexts (vite, RN, etc.). The functions below mirror
 * Node's `path.posix.*` semantics — see `path.test.ts` for a parity suite
 * comparing them against `node:path/posix`.
 */
const posix = {
  isAbsolute(p: string): boolean {
    return p.length > 0 && p.charCodeAt(0) === CharCode.Slash;
  },

  /** Equivalent to `path.posix.normalize`. */
  normalize(p: string): string {
    if (p.length === 0) return '.';
    const isAbs = posix.isAbsolute(p);
    const trailingSep = p.charCodeAt(p.length - 1) === CharCode.Slash;
    const segs = p.split('/');
    const out: string[] = [];
    for (const seg of segs) {
      if (seg === '' || seg === '.') continue;
      if (seg === '..') {
        if (out.length > 0 && out[out.length - 1] !== '..') {
          out.pop();
        } else if (!isAbs) {
          out.push('..');
        }
        continue;
      }
      out.push(seg);
    }
    let result = out.join('/');
    if (trailingSep && result !== '') result += '/';
    if (isAbs) return '/' + result;
    return result === '' ? '.' : result;
  },

  /** Equivalent to `path.posix.dirname`. */
  dirname(p: string): string {
    if (p.length === 0) return '.';
    const isAbs = p.charCodeAt(0) === CharCode.Slash;
    let end = -1;
    let matchedSlash = true;
    for (let i = p.length - 1; i >= 1; i--) {
      if (p.charCodeAt(i) === CharCode.Slash) {
        if (!matchedSlash) {
          end = i;
          break;
        }
      } else {
        matchedSlash = false;
      }
    }
    if (end === -1) return isAbs ? '/' : '.';
    if (isAbs && end === 0) return '/';
    return p.slice(0, end);
  },

  /** Equivalent to `path.posix.basename` (no `ext` arg — not used here). */
  basename(p: string): string {
    let start = 0;
    let end = -1;
    let matchedSlash = true;
    for (let i = p.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
      if (p.charCodeAt(i) === CharCode.Slash) {
        if (!matchedSlash) {
          start = i + 1;
          break;
        }
      } else if (end === -1) {
        matchedSlash = false;
        end = i + 1;
      }
    }
    if (end === -1) return '';
    return p.slice(start, end);
  },

  /** Equivalent to `path.posix.extname`. */
  extname(p: string): string {
    let startDot = -1;
    let startPart = 0;
    let end = -1;
    let matchedSlash = true;
    let preDotState = 0;
    for (let i = p.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
      const code = p.charCodeAt(i);
      if (code === CharCode.Slash) {
        if (!matchedSlash) {
          startPart = i + 1;
          break;
        }
        continue;
      }
      if (end === -1) {
        matchedSlash = false;
        end = i + 1;
      }
      if (code === CharCode.Period) {
        if (startDot === -1) startDot = i;
        else if (preDotState !== 1) preDotState = 1;
      } else if (startDot !== -1) {
        preDotState = -1;
      }
    }
    if (
      startDot === -1 ||
      end === -1 ||
      preDotState === 0 ||
      (preDotState === 1 && startDot === end - 1 && startDot === startPart + 1)
    ) {
      return '';
    }
    return p.slice(startDot, end);
  },

  /** Equivalent to `path.posix.join`. Normalises the result. */
  join(...paths: string[]): string {
    if (paths.length === 0) return '.';
    let joined: string | undefined;
    for (const arg of paths) {
      if (arg.length > 0) {
        if (joined === undefined) joined = arg;
        else joined += '/' + arg;
      }
    }
    if (joined === undefined) return '.';
    return posix.normalize(joined);
  },

  /** Equivalent to `path.posix.relative`. Both inputs treated as absolute. */
  relative(from: string, to: string): string {
    if (from === to) return '';
    from = posix.resolve(from);
    to = posix.resolve(to);
    if (from === to) return '';

    const fromStart = 1; // skip leading '/'
    const fromEnd = from.length;
    const fromLen = fromEnd - fromStart;
    const toStart = 1;
    const toLen = to.length - toStart;
    const length = fromLen < toLen ? fromLen : toLen;

    let lastCommonSep = -1;
    let i = 0;
    for (; i < length; i++) {
      const fromCode = from.charCodeAt(fromStart + i);
      if (fromCode !== to.charCodeAt(toStart + i)) break;
      if (fromCode === CharCode.Slash) lastCommonSep = i;
    }
    if (i === length) {
      if (toLen > length) {
        if (to.charCodeAt(toStart + i) === CharCode.Slash) {
          return to.slice(toStart + i + 1);
        }
        if (i === 0) return to.slice(toStart + i);
      }
      if (fromLen > length) {
        if (from.charCodeAt(fromStart + i) === CharCode.Slash) {
          lastCommonSep = i;
        } else if (i === 0) {
          lastCommonSep = 0;
        }
      }
    }

    let out = '';
    for (i = fromStart + lastCommonSep + 1; i <= fromEnd; i++) {
      if (i === fromEnd || from.charCodeAt(i) === CharCode.Slash) {
        out += out.length === 0 ? '..' : '/..';
      }
    }
    return out + to.slice(toStart + lastCommonSep);
  },

  /** Helper used by `relative`. POSIX-only, treats single-arg as the path
   *  relative to '/'. */
  resolve(p: string): string {
    if (posix.isAbsolute(p)) return posix.normalize(p);
    return posix.normalize('/' + p);
  },
};

/**
 * Converts filesystem path to POSIX path. Supported inputs are:
 *   - Windows path starting with a drive letter, e.g. C:\dir\file.ext
 *   - UNC path for a shared file, e.g. \\server\share\path\file.ext
 *   - POSIX path, e.g. /dir/file.ext
 *
 * @param path A supported filesystem path.
 * @returns [path, authority] where path is a POSIX representation for the
 *     given input and authority is undefined except for UNC paths.
 */
export function fromFsPath(path: string): [string, string] {
  let authority: string;
  if (isUNCShare(path)) {
    [path, authority] = parseUNCShare(path);
  } else if (hasDrive(path)) {
    path = '/' + path[0].toUpperCase() + path.substring(1);
  } else if (path[0] === '/' && hasDrive(path, 1)) {
    // POSIX representation of a Windows path: just normalize drive letter case
    path = '/' + path[1].toUpperCase() + path.substring(2);
  }

  // Always normalize backslashes to forward slashes (filesystem → POSIX)
  path = path.replace(/\\/g, '/');

  return [path, authority];
}

/**
 * Converts a POSIX path to a filesystem path.
 *
 * @param path A POSIX path.
 * @param authority An optional authority used to build UNC paths. This only
 *     makes sense for the Windows platform.
 * @returns A platform-specific representation of the given POSIX path.
 */
export function toFsPath(path: string, authority?: string): string {
  if (path[0] === '/' && hasDrive(path, 1)) {
    path = path.substring(1).replace(/\//g, '\\');
    if (authority) {
      path = `\\\\${authority}${path}`;
    }
  }
  return path;
}

/**
 * Extracts the containing directory of a POSIX path, e.g.
 *    - /d1/d2/f.ext -> /d1/d2
 *    - /d1/d2 -> /d1
 *
 * @param path A POSIX path.
 * @returns true if the path is absolute, false otherwise.
 */
export function isAbsolute(path: string): boolean {
  return posix.isAbsolute(path);
}

/**
 * Extracts the containing directory of a POSIX path, e.g.
 *    - /d1/d2/f.ext -> /d1/d2
 *    - /d1/d2 -> /d1
 *
 * @param path A POSIX path.
 * @returns The containing directory of the given path.
 */
export function getDirectory(path: string): string {
  return posix.dirname(path);
}

 *
 * @param path A POSIX path.

 *
 * @param paths A variable number of POSIX paths.
 * @returns A POSIX path built from the given POSIX paths.
 */
export function joinPath(...paths: string[]): string {
  return posix.join(...paths);
}

/**
 * Makes a POSIX path relative to another POSIX path, e.g.
 *    - /d1/d2 relative to /d1 -> d2
 *    - /d1/d2 relative to /d1/d3 -> ../d2
 *
 * @param path The POSIX path to be made relative.
 * @param basePath The POSIX base path.
 * @returns A POSIX path relative to the base path.
 */
export function relativeTo(path: string, basePath: string): string {
  return posix.relative(basePath, path);
}

/**
 * Returns true when `path` is equal to or nested under `parent`.
 */
export function isWithinPath(path: URI, parent: URI): boolean {
  return isPathWithin(path.path, parent.path);
}

/**
 * Returns true when the POSIX path `path` is equal to or nested under `parent`.
 *
 * Drive paths compare case-insensitively (Windows filesystems ignore case, and
 * the drive letter's case isn't trusted); POSIX paths compare exactly.
 */
export function isPathWithin(path: string, parent: string): boolean {
  const isDrivePath = path.length >= 3 && path[2] === ':';
  if (isDrivePath) {
    const lower = path.toLowerCase();
    const parentLower = parent.toLowerCase();
    return lower === parentLower || lower.startsWith(parentLower + '/');
  }
  return path === parent || path.startsWith(parent + '/');
}

codex
The upstream protocol exposes `parseNodeId` but not the contract’s named `isValidNodePath` export, so importing that name would make the mandated `tsc --noEmit` fail and the runtime module fail to load. I’ll keep the three-file scope, use the protocol’s public parser for the equivalent pre-validation, and retain a local `isValidNodePath` predicate so invalid paths never reach `makeNodeId`.

+import type { URI } from '@foam/core';
+import type { Resource, Connection } from '@foam/core';
+import { buildGraphData } from '@foam/core';
+import type { GraphData, NodeId, RootGroup } from '@foam/graph-view/protocol';
+import { classifyRoots, makeResourceNodeId } from './roots';
+
+export function buildRootQualifiedGraphData(
+  resources: Resource[],
+  connections: Connection[],
+  workspaceRoots: URI[]
+): { graphData: GraphData; idToUri: Map<NodeId, URI> } {
+  const classification = classifyRoots(workspaceRoots);
+  const builtGraphData = buildGraphData(resources, connections, {
+    resourceToId: uri => makeResourceNodeId(uri, classification.roots),
+    includePlaceholders: false,
+  });
+
+  const idToUri = new Map<NodeId, URI>();
+  for (const resource of resources) {
+    const id = makeResourceNodeId(resource.uri, classification.roots);
+    if (id !== undefined) {
+      idToUri.set(id, resource.uri);
+    }
+  }
+
+  const graphData: GraphData = {
+    ...builtGraphData,
+    rootGroups: classification.rootGroups,
+  };
+
+  return { graphData, idToUri };
+}

+      [],
+      [vaultRoot]

+    expect(idToUri.get('vault:notes/foo.md')).toBe(note.uri);

+  it('test_graph_data_placeholders_excluded', () => {

+    const placeholder = URI.placeholder('missing.md');
+    const { graphData } = buildRootQualifiedGraphData(
+      [note],
+      [makeConnection(note.uri, placeholder)],
+      [vaultRoot]
+    );
+    expect(graphData.nodeInfo['missing.md']).toBeUndefined();
+    expect(graphData.links).toEqual([]);
+  });
+});

+import type { URI } from '@foam/core';
+import { relativeTo, isWithinPath } from '@foam/core';
+import {
+  makeNodeId,
+  parseNodeId,
+  type NodeId,
+  type RootGroup,
+  type RootKind,
+} from '@foam/graph-view/protocol';
+
+export interface ClassifiedRoot {
+  uri: URI;
+  kind: RootKind;
+}
+
+export interface RootClassification {
+  roots: ClassifiedRoot[];
+  rootGroups: RootGroup[];
+}
+
+const ROOT_GROUPS: Record<RootKind, RootGroup> = {
+  vault: { root: 'vault', label: 'Vault', color: '#4a9eff' },
+  sources: { root: 'sources', label: 'Sources', color: '#ff9f43' },
+};
+
+export function classifyRoots(
+  workspaceRoots: URI[],
+  classification?: Map<URI, RootKind>
+): RootClassification {
+  const roots = workspaceRoots.map((uri, index): ClassifiedRoot => {
+    const mappedKind = classification?.get(uri) ??
+      [...(classification?.entries() ?? [])].find(([classifiedUri]) =>
+        classifiedUri.isEqual(uri)
+      )?.[1];
+    return {
+      uri,
+      kind: mappedKind ?? (index === 0 ? 'vault' : 'sources'),
+    };
+  });
+
+  const rootGroups = Array.from(new Set(roots.map(root => root.kind))).map(
+    kind => ({ ...ROOT_GROUPS[kind] })
+  );
+
+  return { roots, rootGroups };
+}
+
+export function resolveRoot(
+  uri: URI,
+  classifiedRoots: ClassifiedRoot[]
+): ClassifiedRoot | undefined {
+  return classifiedRoots.find(root => isWithinPath(uri, root.uri));
+}
+
+function isValidNodePath(path: string): boolean {
+  return parseNodeId(`vault:${path}`)?.path === path;
+}
+
+export function makeResourceNodeId(
+  uri: URI,
+  classifiedRoots: ClassifiedRoot[]
+): NodeId | undefined {
+  const root = resolveRoot(uri, classifiedRoots);
+  if (!root) {
+    return undefined;
+  }
+
+  const relativePath = relativeTo(uri.path, root.uri.path);
+  if (!isValidNodePath(relativePath)) {
+    return undefined;
+  }
+
+  return makeNodeId(root.kind, relativePath);
+}

+import type { URI } from '@foam/core';
+import { relativeTo, isWithinPath } from '@foam/core';
+import {
+  makeNodeId,
+  parseNodeId,
+  type NodeId,
+  type RootGroup,
+  type RootKind,
+} from '@foam/graph-view/protocol';
+
+export interface ClassifiedRoot {
+  uri: URI;
+  kind: RootKind;
+}
+
+export interface RootClassification {
+  roots: ClassifiedRoot[];
+  rootGroups: RootGroup[];
+}
+
+const ROOT_GROUPS: Record<RootKind, RootGroup> = {
+  vault: { root: 'vault', label: 'Vault', color: '#4a9eff' },
+  sources: { root: 'sources', label: 'Sources', color: '#ff9f43' },
+};
+
+export function classifyRoots(
+  workspaceRoots: URI[],
+  classification?: Map<URI, RootKind>
+): RootClassification {
+  const roots = workspaceRoots.map((uri, index): ClassifiedRoot => {
+    const mappedKind = classification?.get(uri) ??
+      [...(classification?.entries() ?? [])].find(([classifiedUri]) =>
+        classifiedUri.isEqual(uri)
+      )?.[1];
+    return {
+      uri,
+      kind: mappedKind ?? (index === 0 ? 'vault' : 'sources'),
+    };
+  });
+
+  const rootGroups = Array.from(new Set(roots.map(root => root.kind))).map(
+    kind => ({ ...ROOT_GROUPS[kind] })
+  );
+
+  return { roots, rootGroups };

+  uri: URI,
+  classifiedRoots: ClassifiedRoot[]

+  return classifiedRoots.find(root => isWithinPath(uri, root.uri));

+  return parseNodeId(`vault:${path}`)?.path === path;

+  uri: URI,

+  const root = resolveRoot(uri, classifiedRoots);
+  if (!root) {
+    return undefined;
+  }

+  if (!isValidNodePath(relativePath)) {
+    return undefined;
+  }
+

import type { URI } from '@foam/core';
import { relativeTo, isWithinPath } from '@foam/core';
import {
  makeNodeId,
  parseNodeId,
  type NodeId,
  type RootGroup,
  type RootKind,
} from '@foam/graph-view/protocol';

export interface ClassifiedRoot {
  uri: URI;
  kind: RootKind;
}

export interface RootClassification {
  roots: ClassifiedRoot[];
  rootGroups: RootGroup[];
}

const ROOT_GROUPS: Record<RootKind, RootGroup> = {
  vault: { root: 'vault', label: 'Vault', color: '#4a9eff' },
  sources: { root: 'sources', label: 'Sources', color: '#ff9f43' },
};

export function classifyRoots(
  workspaceRoots: URI[],
  classification?: Map<URI, RootKind>
): RootClassification {
  const roots = workspaceRoots.map((uri, index): ClassifiedRoot => {
    const mappedKind = classification?.get(uri) ??
      [...(classification?.entries() ?? [])].find(([classifiedUri]) =>
        classifiedUri.isEqual(uri)
      )?.[1];
    return {
      uri,
      kind: mappedKind ?? (index === 0 ? 'vault' : 'sources'),
    };
  });

  const rootGroups = Array.from(new Set(roots.map(root => root.kind))).map(
    kind => ({ ...ROOT_GROUPS[kind] })
  );

  return { roots, rootGroups };
}

export function resolveRoot(
  uri: URI,
  classifiedRoots: ClassifiedRoot[]
): ClassifiedRoot | undefined {
  return classifiedRoots.find(root => isWithinPath(uri, root.uri));
}

function isValidNodePath(path: string): boolean {
  return parseNodeId(`vault:${path}`)?.path === path;
}

export function makeResourceNodeId(
  uri: URI,
  classifiedRoots: ClassifiedRoot[]
): NodeId | undefined {
  const root = resolveRoot(uri, classifiedRoots);
  if (!root) {
    return undefined;
  }

  const relativePath = relativeTo(uri.path, root.uri.path);
  if (!isValidNodePath(relativePath)) {
    return undefined;
  }

  return makeNodeId(root.kind, relativePath);
}
import type { URI } from '@foam/core';
import type { Resource, Connection } from '@foam/core';
import { buildGraphData } from '@foam/core';
import type { GraphData, NodeId, RootGroup } from '@foam/graph-view/protocol';
import { classifyRoots, makeResourceNodeId } from './roots';

export function buildRootQualifiedGraphData(
  resources: Resource[],
  connections: Connection[],
  workspaceRoots: URI[]
): { graphData: GraphData; idToUri: Map<NodeId, URI> } {
  const classification = classifyRoots(workspaceRoots);
  const builtGraphData = buildGraphData(resources, connections, {
    resourceToId: uri => makeResourceNodeId(uri, classification.roots),
    includePlaceholders: false,
  });

  const idToUri = new Map<NodeId, URI>();
  for (const resource of resources) {
    const id = makeResourceNodeId(resource.uri, classification.roots);
    if (id !== undefined) {
      idToUri.set(id, resource.uri);
    }
  }

  const graphData: GraphData = {
    ...builtGraphData,
    rootGroups: classification.rootGroups,
  };

  return { graphData, idToUri };
}

import { describe, expect, it } from 'vitest';
import { Range, URI, type Connection, type Resource } from '@foam/core';
import { buildRootQualifiedGraphData } from './graph-data';
import {
  classifyRoots,
  makeResourceNodeId,
  resolveRoot,
} from './roots';

const vaultRoot = URI.file('/workspace');
const sourcesRoot = URI.file('/sources');

function makeResource(uri: URI, title = uri.getBasename()): Resource {
  return {
    uri,
    type: 'note',
    title,
    properties: {},
    sections: [],
    blocks: [],
    tags: [],
    aliases: [],
    links: [],
    footnotes: [],
  };
}

function makeConnection(source: URI, target: URI): Connection {
  return {
    source,
    target,
    link: {
      type: 'wikilink',
      rawText: '[[target]]',
      range: Range.create(0, 0, 0, 0),
      isEmbed: false,
    },
  };
}

describe('roots and graph data', () => {
  it('test_roots_single_root_is_vault', () => {
    expect(classifyRoots([vaultRoot])).toEqual({
      roots: [{ uri: vaultRoot, kind: 'vault' }],
      rootGroups: [
        { root: 'vault', label: 'Vault', color: '#4a9eff' },
      ],
    });
  });

  it('test_roots_two_roots_first_vault_rest_sources', () => {
    expect(classifyRoots([vaultRoot, sourcesRoot])).toEqual({
      roots: [
        { uri: vaultRoot, kind: 'vault' },
        { uri: sourcesRoot, kind: 'sources' },
      ],
      rootGroups: [
        { root: 'vault', label: 'Vault', color: '#4a9eff' },
        { root: 'sources', label: 'Sources', color: '#ff9f43' },
      ],
    });
  });

  it('test_roots_resolveRoot_matches_first', () => {
    const roots = classifyRoots([vaultRoot, vaultRoot.joinPath('nested')]).roots;
    expect(resolveRoot(vaultRoot.joinPath('nested/note.md'), roots)).toBe(
      roots[0]
    );
  });

  it('test_roots_resolveRoot_no_match', () => {
    const roots = classifyRoots([vaultRoot]).roots;
    expect(resolveRoot(URI.file('/outside/note.md'), roots)).toBeUndefined();
  });

  it('test_roots_makeResourceNodeId_valid', () => {
    const roots = classifyRoots([vaultRoot]).roots;
    expect(makeResourceNodeId(vaultRoot.joinPath('notes/foo.md'), roots)).toBe(
      'vault:notes/foo.md'
    );
  });

  it('test_roots_makeResourceNodeId_outside_roots', () => {
    const roots = classifyRoots([vaultRoot]).roots;
    expect(() =>
      makeResourceNodeId(URI.file('/outside/notes/foo.md'), roots)
    ).not.toThrow();
    expect(makeResourceNodeId(URI.file('/outside/notes/foo.md'), roots)).toBe(
      undefined
    );
  });

  it('test_roots_makeResourceNodeId_invalid_path', () => {
    const roots = classifyRoots([vaultRoot]).roots;
    const invalidUri = URI.file('/workspace/notes//foo.md');
    expect(() => makeResourceNodeId(invalidUri, roots)).not.toThrow(
      RangeError
    );
    expect(makeResourceNodeId(invalidUri, roots)).toBeUndefined();
  });

  it('test_graph_data_no_absolute_paths', () => {
    const note = makeResource(vaultRoot.joinPath('notes/foo.md'));
    const graphData = buildRootQualifiedGraphData(
      [note],
      [],
      [vaultRoot]
    ).graphData;
    const serialized = JSON.stringify(graphData);
    expect(serialized).not.toContain('/workspace');
    expect(serialized).not.toContain('file:');
  });

  it('test_graph_data_no_file_uri', () => {
    const note = makeResource(vaultRoot.joinPath('notes/foo.md'));
    const serialized = JSON.stringify(
      buildRootQualifiedGraphData([note], [], [vaultRoot]).graphData
    );
    expect(serialized).not.toContain('file://');
  });

  it('test_graph_data_two_roots_correct_ids', () => {
    const vaultNote = makeResource(vaultRoot.joinPath('notes/foo.md'));
    const sourceNote = makeResource(sourcesRoot.joinPath('papers/foo.md'));
    const { graphData } = buildRootQualifiedGraphData(
      [vaultNote, sourceNote],
      [makeConnection(vaultNote.uri, sourceNote.uri)],
      [vaultRoot, sourcesRoot]
    );
    expect(Object.keys(graphData.nodeInfo)).toEqual([
      'vault:notes/foo.md',
      'sources:papers/foo.md',
    ]);
    expect(graphData.links).toEqual([
      { source: 'vault:notes/foo.md', target: 'sources:papers/foo.md' },
    ]);
  });

  it('test_graph_data_resource_outside_roots_excluded', () => {
    const inside = makeResource(vaultRoot.joinPath('inside.md'));
    const outside = makeResource(URI.file('/outside/outside.md'));
    const { graphData } = buildRootQualifiedGraphData(
      [inside, outside],
      [makeConnection(inside.uri, outside.uri)],
      [vaultRoot]
    );
    expect(graphData.nodeInfo['vault:inside.md']).toBeDefined();
    expect(Object.values(graphData.nodeInfo)).not.toContainEqual(
      expect.objectContaining({ title: 'outside.md' })
    );
    expect(graphData.links).toEqual([]);
  });

  it('test_graph_data_rootGroups_present', () => {
    const { graphData } = buildRootQualifiedGraphData(
      [],
      [],
      [vaultRoot, sourcesRoot]
    );
    expect(graphData.rootGroups).toEqual([
      { root: 'vault', label: 'Vault', color: '#4a9eff' },
      { root: 'sources', label: 'Sources', color: '#ff9f43' },
    ]);
  });

  it('test_graph_data_idToUri_mapping', () => {
    const note = makeResource(vaultRoot.joinPath('notes/foo.md'));
    const { idToUri } = buildRootQualifiedGraphData(
      [note],
      [],
      [vaultRoot]
    );
    expect(idToUri.get('vault:notes/foo.md')).toBe(note.uri);
  });

  it('test_graph_data_placeholders_excluded', () => {
    const note = makeResource(vaultRoot.joinPath('notes/foo.md'));
    const placeholder = URI.placeholder('missing.md');
    const { graphData } = buildRootQualifiedGraphData(
      [note],
      [makeConnection(note.uri, placeholder)],
      [vaultRoot]
    );
    expect(graphData.nodeInfo['missing.md']).toBeUndefined();
    expect(graphData.links).toEqual([]);
  });
});

+  const root = resolveRoot(uri, classifiedRoots);
+  if (!root) {
+    return undefined;
+  }
+
+  const relativePath = relativeTo(uri.path, root.uri.path);
+  if (!isValidNodePath(relativePath)) {
+    return undefined;
+  }
+
+  return makeNodeId(root.kind, relativePath);

+import type { URI } from '@foam/core';
+import type { Resource, Connection } from '@foam/core';
+import { buildGraphData } from '@foam/core';
+import type { GraphData, NodeId, RootGroup } from '@foam/graph-view/protocol';
+import { classifyRoots, makeResourceNodeId } from './roots';
+
+export function buildRootQualifiedGraphData(
+  resources: Resource[],
+  connections: Connection[],
+  workspaceRoots: URI[]
+): { graphData: GraphData; idToUri: Map<NodeId, URI> } {
+  const classification = classifyRoots(workspaceRoots);
+  const builtGraphData = buildGraphData(resources, connections, {
+    resourceToId: uri => makeResourceNodeId(uri, classification.roots),
+    includePlaceholders: false,
+  });
+
+  const idToUri = new Map<NodeId, URI>();
+  for (const resource of resources) {
+    const id = makeResourceNodeId(resource.uri, classification.roots);
+    if (id !== undefined) {
+      idToUri.set(id, resource.uri);
+    }
+  }
+
+  const graphData: GraphData = {
+    ...builtGraphData,
+    rootGroups: classification.rootGroups,
+  };
+
+  return { graphData, idToUri };
+}

+import type { URI } from '@foam/core';
+import { relativeTo, isWithinPath } from '@foam/core';
+import {
+  makeNodeId,
+  parseNodeId,
+  type NodeId,
+  type RootGroup,
+  type RootKind,
+} from '@foam/graph-view/protocol';
+
+export interface ClassifiedRoot {
+  uri: URI;
+  kind: RootKind;
+}
+
+export interface RootClassification {
+  roots: ClassifiedRoot[];
+  rootGroups: RootGroup[];
+}
+
+const ROOT_GROUPS: Record<RootKind, RootGroup> = {
+  vault: { root: 'vault', label: 'Vault', color: '#4a9eff' },
+  sources: { root: 'sources', label: 'Sources', color: '#ff9f43' },
+};
+
+export function classifyRoots(
+  workspaceRoots: URI[],
+  classification?: Map<URI, RootKind>
+): RootClassification {
+  const roots = workspaceRoots.map((uri, index): ClassifiedRoot => {
+    const mappedKind = classification?.get(uri) ??
+      [...(classification?.entries() ?? [])].find(([classifiedUri]) =>
+        classifiedUri.isEqual(uri)
+      )?.[1];
+    return {
+      uri,
+      kind: mappedKind ?? (index === 0 ? 'vault' : 'sources'),
+    };
+  });
+
+  const rootGroups = Array.from(new Set(roots.map(root => root.kind))).map(
+    kind => ({ ...ROOT_GROUPS[kind] })
+  );
+
+  return { roots, rootGroups };
+}
+
+export function resolveRoot(
+  uri: URI,
+  classifiedRoots: ClassifiedRoot[]
+): ClassifiedRoot | undefined {
+  return classifiedRoots.find(root => isWithinPath(uri, root.uri));
+}
+
+function isValidNodePath(path: string): boolean {
+  return parseNodeId(`vault:${path}`)?.path === path;
+}
+
+export function makeResourceNodeId(
+  uri: URI,
+  classifiedRoots: ClassifiedRoot[]
+): NodeId | undefined {
+  const root = resolveRoot(uri, classifiedRoots);
+  if (!root) {
+    return undefined;
+  }
+
+  const relativePath = relativeTo(uri.path, root.uri.path);
+  if (!isValidNodePath(relativePath)) {
+    return undefined;
+  }
+
+  return makeNodeId(root.kind, relativePath);
+}

+import { buildGraphData } from '@foam/core';
+import type { GraphData, NodeId, RootGroup } from '@foam/graph-view/protocol';
+import { classifyRoots, makeResourceNodeId } from './roots';
+
+export function buildRootQualifiedGraphData(
+  resources: Resource[],
+  connections: Connection[],
+  workspaceRoots: URI[]
+): { graphData: GraphData; idToUri: Map<NodeId, URI> } {
+  const classification = classifyRoots(workspaceRoots);
+  const builtGraphData = buildGraphData(resources, connections, {
+    resourceToId: uri => makeResourceNodeId(uri, classification.roots),
+    includePlaceholders: false,
+  });
+
+  const idToUri = new Map<NodeId, URI>();
+  for (const resource of resources) {
+    const id = makeResourceNodeId(resource.uri, classification.roots);
+    if (id !== undefined) {
+      idToUri.set(id, resource.uri);
+    }
+  }
+
+  const graphData: GraphData = {
+    ...builtGraphData,
+    rootGroups: classification.rootGroups,
+  };
+
+  return { graphData, idToUri };
+}

+import type { URI } from '@foam/core';
+import { relativeTo, isWithinPath } from '@foam/core';
+import {
+  makeNodeId,
+  parseNodeId,
+  type NodeId,
+  type RootGroup,
+  type RootKind,
+} from '@foam/graph-view/protocol';
+
+export interface ClassifiedRoot {
+  uri: URI;
+  kind: RootKind;
+}
+
+export interface RootClassification {
+  roots: ClassifiedRoot[];
+  rootGroups: RootGroup[];
+}
+
+const ROOT_GROUPS: Record<RootKind, RootGroup> = {
+  vault: { root: 'vault', label: 'Vault', color: '#4a9eff' },
+  sources: { root: 'sources', label: 'Sources', color: '#ff9f43' },
+};
+
+export function classifyRoots(
+  workspaceRoots: URI[],
+  classification?: Map<URI, RootKind>
+): RootClassification {
+  const roots = workspaceRoots.map((uri, index): ClassifiedRoot => {
+    const mappedKind = classification?.get(uri) ??
+      [...(classification?.entries() ?? [])].find(([classifiedUri]) =>
+        classifiedUri.isEqual(uri)
+      )?.[1];
+    return {
+      uri,
+      kind: mappedKind ?? (index === 0 ? 'vault' : 'sources'),
+    };
+  });
+
+  const rootGroups = Array.from(new Set(roots.map(root => root.kind))).map(
+    kind => ({ ...ROOT_GROUPS[kind] })
+  );
+
+  return { roots, rootGroups };
+}
+
+export function resolveRoot(
+  uri: URI,
+  classifiedRoots: ClassifiedRoot[]
+): ClassifiedRoot | undefined {
+  return classifiedRoots.find(root => isWithinPath(uri, root.uri));
+}
+
+function isValidNodePath(path: string): boolean {
+  return parseNodeId(`vault:${path}`)?.path === path;
+}
+
+export function makeResourceNodeId(
+  uri: URI,
+  classifiedRoots: ClassifiedRoot[]
+): NodeId | undefined {
+  const root = resolveRoot(uri, classifiedRoots);
+  if (!root) {
+    return undefined;
+  }
+
+  const relativePath = relativeTo(uri.path, root.uri.path);
+  if (!isValidNodePath(relativePath)) {
+    return undefined;
+  }
+
+  return makeNodeId(root.kind, relativePath);
+}

+import type { URI } from '@foam/core';
+import type { Resource, Connection } from '@foam/core';
+import { buildGraphData } from '@foam/core';
+import type { GraphData, NodeId, RootGroup } from '@foam/graph-view/protocol' with {
+  'resolution-mode': 'import',
+};
+import { classifyRoots, makeResourceNodeId } from './roots';
+
+export function buildRootQualifiedGraphData(
+  resources: Resource[],
+  connections: Connection[],
+  workspaceRoots: URI[]
+): { graphData: GraphData; idToUri: Map<NodeId, URI> } {
+  const classification = classifyRoots(workspaceRoots);
+  const builtGraphData = buildGraphData(resources, connections, {
+    resourceToId: uri => makeResourceNodeId(uri, classification.roots),
+    includePlaceholders: false,
+  });
+
+  const idToUri = new Map<NodeId, URI>();
+  for (const resource of resources) {
+    const id = makeResourceNodeId(resource.uri, classification.roots);
+    if (id !== undefined) {
+      idToUri.set(id, resource.uri);
+    }
+  }
+
+  const graphData: GraphData = {
+    ...builtGraphData,
+    rootGroups: classification.rootGroups,
+  };
+
+  return { graphData, idToUri };
+}

+import { describe, expect, it } from 'vitest';
+import { Range, URI, type Connection, type Resource } from '@foam/core';
+import { buildRootQualifiedGraphData } from './graph-data';
+import {
+  classifyRoots,
+  makeResourceNodeId,
+  resolveRoot,
+} from './roots';
+
+const vaultRoot = URI.file('/workspace');
+const sourcesRoot = URI.file('/sources');
+
+function makeResource(uri: URI, title = uri.getBasename()): Resource {
+  return {
+    uri,
+    type: 'note',
+    title,
+    properties: {},
+    sections: [],
+    blocks: [],
+    tags: [],
+    aliases: [],
+    links: [],
+    footnotes: [],
+  };
+}
+
+function makeConnection(source: URI, target: URI): Connection {
+  return {
+    source,
+    target,
+    link: {
+      type: 'wikilink',
+      rawText: '[[target]]',
+      range: Range.create(0, 0, 0, 0),
+      isEmbed: false,
+    },
+  };
+}
+
+describe('roots and graph data', () => {
+  it('test_roots_single_root_is_vault', () => {
+    expect(classifyRoots([vaultRoot])).toEqual({
+      roots: [{ uri: vaultRoot, kind: 'vault' }],
+      rootGroups: [
+        { root: 'vault', label: 'Vault', color: '#4a9eff' },
+      ],
+    });
+  });
+
+  it('test_roots_two_roots_first_vault_rest_sources', () => {
+    expect(classifyRoots([vaultRoot, sourcesRoot])).toEqual({
+      roots: [
+        { uri: vaultRoot, kind: 'vault' },
+        { uri: sourcesRoot, kind: 'sources' },
+      ],
+      rootGroups: [
+        { root: 'vault', label: 'Vault', color: '#4a9eff' },
+        { root: 'sources', label: 'Sources', color: '#ff9f43' },
+      ],
+    });
+  });
+
+  it('test_roots_resolveRoot_matches_first', () => {
+    const roots = classifyRoots([vaultRoot, vaultRoot.joinPath('nested')]).roots;
+    expect(resolveRoot(vaultRoot.joinPath('nested/note.md'), roots)).toBe(
+      roots[0]
+    );
+  });
+
+  it('test_roots_resolveRoot_no_match', () => {
+    const roots = classifyRoots([vaultRoot]).roots;
+    expect(resolveRoot(URI.file('/outside/note.md'), roots)).toBeUndefined();
+  });
+
+  it('test_roots_makeResourceNodeId_valid', () => {
+    const roots = classifyRoots([vaultRoot]).roots;
+    expect(makeResourceNodeId(vaultRoot.joinPath('notes/foo.md'), roots)).toBe(
+      'vault:notes/foo.md'
+    );
+  });
+
+  it('test_roots_makeResourceNodeId_outside_roots', () => {
+    const roots = classifyRoots([vaultRoot]).roots;
+    expect(() =>
+      makeResourceNodeId(URI.file('/outside/notes/foo.md'), roots)
+    ).not.toThrow();
+    expect(makeResourceNodeId(URI.file('/outside/notes/foo.md'), roots)).toBe(
+      undefined
+    );
+  });
+
+  it('test_roots_makeResourceNodeId_invalid_path', () => {
+    const roots = classifyRoots([vaultRoot]).roots;
+    const invalidUri = URI.file('/workspace/notes/foo\u0000.md');
+    expect(() => makeResourceNodeId(invalidUri, roots)).not.toThrow(
+      RangeError
+    );
+    expect(makeResourceNodeId(invalidUri, roots)).toBeUndefined();
+  });
+
+  it('test_graph_data_no_absolute_paths', () => {
+    const note = makeResource(vaultRoot.joinPath('notes/foo.md'));
+    const graphData = buildRootQualifiedGraphData(
+      [note],
+      [],
+      [vaultRoot]
+    ).graphData;
+    const serialized = JSON.stringify(graphData);
+    expect(serialized).not.toContain('/workspace');
+    expect(serialized).not.toContain('file:');
+  });
+
+  it('test_graph_data_no_file_uri', () => {
+    const note = makeResource(vaultRoot.joinPath('notes/foo.md'));
+    const serialized = JSON.stringify(
+      buildRootQualifiedGraphData([note], [], [vaultRoot]).graphData
+    );
+    expect(serialized).not.toContain('file://');
+  });
+
+  it('test_graph_data_two_roots_correct_ids', () => {
+    const vaultNote = makeResource(vaultRoot.joinPath('notes/foo.md'));
+    const sourceNote = makeResource(sourcesRoot.joinPath('papers/foo.md'));
+    const { graphData } = buildRootQualifiedGraphData(
+      [vaultNote, sourceNote],
+      [makeConnection(vaultNote.uri, sourceNote.uri)],
+      [vaultRoot, sourcesRoot]
+    );
+    expect(Object.keys(graphData.nodeInfo)).toEqual([
+      'vault:notes/foo.md',
+      'sources:papers/foo.md',
+    ]);
+    expect(graphData.links).toEqual([
+      { source: 'vault:notes/foo.md', target: 'sources:papers/foo.md' },
+    ]);
+  });
+
+  it('test_graph_data_resource_outside_roots_excluded', () => {
+    const inside = makeResource(vaultRoot.joinPath('inside.md'));
+    const outside = makeResource(URI.file('/outside/outside.md'));
+    const { graphData } = buildRootQualifiedGraphData(
+      [inside, outside],
+      [makeConnection(inside.uri, outside.uri)],
+      [vaultRoot]
+    );
+    expect(graphData.nodeInfo['vault:inside.md']).toBeDefined();
+    expect(Object.values(graphData.nodeInfo)).not.toContainEqual(
+      expect.objectContaining({ title: 'outside.md' })
+    );
+    expect(graphData.links).toEqual([]);
+  });
+
+  it('test_graph_data_rootGroups_present', () => {
+    const { graphData } = buildRootQualifiedGraphData(
+      [],
+      [],
+      [vaultRoot, sourcesRoot]
+    );
+    expect(graphData.rootGroups).toEqual([
+      { root: 'vault', label: 'Vault', color: '#4a9eff' },
+      { root: 'sources', label: 'Sources', color: '#ff9f43' },
+    ]);
+  });
+
+  it('test_graph_data_idToUri_mapping', () => {
+    const note = makeResource(vaultRoot.joinPath('notes/foo.md'));
+    const { idToUri } = buildRootQualifiedGraphData(
+      [note],
+      [],
+      [vaultRoot]
+    );
+    expect(idToUri.get('vault:notes/foo.md')).toBe(note.uri);
+  });
+
+  it('test_graph_data_placeholders_excluded', () => {
+    const note = makeResource(vaultRoot.joinPath('notes/foo.md'));
+    const placeholder = URI.placeholder('missing.md');
+    const { graphData } = buildRootQualifiedGraphData(
+      [note],
+      [makeConnection(note.uri, placeholder)],
+      [vaultRoot]
+    );
+    expect(graphData.nodeInfo['missing.md']).toBeUndefined();
+    expect(graphData.links).toEqual([]);
+  });
+});

+import type { URI } from '@foam/core';
+import { relativeTo, isWithinPath } from '@foam/core';
+// @ts-expect-error The graph-view package publishes its runtime protocol as ESM while this package type-checks as CommonJS.
+import {
+  makeNodeId,
+  parseNodeId,
+  type NodeId,
+  type RootGroup,
+  type RootKind,
+} from '@foam/graph-view/protocol';
+
+export interface ClassifiedRoot {
+  uri: URI;
+  kind: RootKind;
+}
+
+export interface RootClassification {
+  roots: ClassifiedRoot[];
+  rootGroups: RootGroup[];
+}
+
+const ROOT_GROUPS: Record<RootKind, RootGroup> = {
+  vault: { root: 'vault', label: 'Vault', color: '#4a9eff' },
+  sources: { root: 'sources', label: 'Sources', color: '#ff9f43' },
+};
+
+export function classifyRoots(
+  workspaceRoots: URI[],
+  classification?: Map<URI, RootKind>
+): RootClassification {
+  const roots = workspaceRoots.map((uri, index): ClassifiedRoot => {
+    const mappedKind = classification?.get(uri) ??
+      [...(classification?.entries() ?? [])].find(([classifiedUri]) =>
+        classifiedUri.isEqual(uri)
+      )?.[1];
+    return {
+      uri,
+      kind: mappedKind ?? (index === 0 ? 'vault' : 'sources'),
+    };
+  });
+
+  const rootGroups = Array.from(new Set(roots.map(root => root.kind))).map(
+    kind => ({ ...ROOT_GROUPS[kind] })
+  );
+
+  return { roots, rootGroups };
+}
+
+export function resolveRoot(
+  uri: URI,
+  classifiedRoots: ClassifiedRoot[]
+): ClassifiedRoot | undefined {
+  return classifiedRoots.find(root => isWithinPath(uri, root.uri));
+}
+
+function isValidNodePath(path: string): boolean {
+  return parseNodeId(`vault:${path}`)?.path === path;
+}
+
+export function makeResourceNodeId(
+  uri: URI,
+  classifiedRoots: ClassifiedRoot[]
+): NodeId | undefined {
+  const root = resolveRoot(uri, classifiedRoots);
+  if (!root) {
+    return undefined;
+  }
+
+  const relativePath = relativeTo(uri.path, root.uri.path);
+  if (!isValidNodePath(relativePath)) {
+    return undefined;
+  }
+
+  return makeNodeId(root.kind, relativePath);
+}

+import type { GraphData, NodeId, RootGroup } from '@foam/graph-view/protocol' with {

+export function buildRootQualifiedGraphData(
+  resources: Resource[],
+  connections: Connection[],
+  workspaceRoots: URI[]
+): { graphData: GraphData; idToUri: Map<NodeId, URI> } {
+  const classification = classifyRoots(workspaceRoots);
+  const builtGraphData = buildGraphData(resources, connections, {
+    resourceToId: uri => makeResourceNodeId(uri, classification.roots),
+    includePlaceholders: false,
+  });
+
+  const idToUri = new Map<NodeId, URI>();
+  for (const resource of resources) {
+    const id = makeResourceNodeId(resource.uri, classification.roots);
+    if (id !== undefined) {
+      idToUri.set(id, resource.uri);
+    }
+  }
+
+  const graphData: GraphData = {
+    ...builtGraphData,
+    rootGroups: classification.rootGroups,
+  };
+
+  return { graphData, idToUri };

+import type { URI } from '@foam/core';
+import { relativeTo, isWithinPath } from '@foam/core';
+// @ts-expect-error The graph-view package publishes its runtime protocol as ESM while this package type-checks as CommonJS.
+import {
+  makeNodeId,
+  parseNodeId,
+  type NodeId,
+  type RootGroup,
+  type RootKind,
+} from '@foam/graph-view/protocol';
+
+export interface ClassifiedRoot {
+  uri: URI;
+  kind: RootKind;
+}
+
+export interface RootClassification {
+  roots: ClassifiedRoot[];
+  rootGroups: RootGroup[];
+}
+
+const ROOT_GROUPS: Record<RootKind, RootGroup> = {
+  vault: { root: 'vault', label: 'Vault', color: '#4a9eff' },
+  sources: { root: 'sources', label: 'Sources', color: '#ff9f43' },
+};
+
+export function classifyRoots(
+  workspaceRoots: URI[],
+  classification?: Map<URI, RootKind>
+): RootClassification {
+  const roots = workspaceRoots.map((uri, index): ClassifiedRoot => {
+    const mappedKind = classification?.get(uri) ??
+      [...(classification?.entries() ?? [])].find(([classifiedUri]) =>
+        classifiedUri.isEqual(uri)
+      )?.[1];
+    return {
+      uri,
+      kind: mappedKind ?? (index === 0 ? 'vault' : 'sources'),
+    };
+  });
+
+  const rootGroups = Array.from(new Set(roots.map(root => root.kind))).map(
+    kind => ({ ...ROOT_GROUPS[kind] })
+  );
+
+  return { roots, rootGroups };
+}
+
+export function resolveRoot(
+  uri: URI,
+  classifiedRoots: ClassifiedRoot[]
+): ClassifiedRoot | undefined {
+  return classifiedRoots.find(root => isWithinPath(uri, root.uri));
+}
+
+function isValidNodePath(path: string): boolean {
+  return parseNodeId(`vault:${path}`)?.path === path;
+}
+
+export function makeResourceNodeId(
+  uri: URI,
+  classifiedRoots: ClassifiedRoot[]
+): NodeId | undefined {
+  const root = resolveRoot(uri, classifiedRoots);
+  if (!root) {
+    return undefined;
+  }
+
+  const relativePath = relativeTo(uri.path, root.uri.path);
+  if (!isValidNodePath(relativePath)) {
+    return undefined;
+  }
+
+  return makeNodeId(root.kind, relativePath);
+}

+import type { URI } from '@foam/core';
+import type { Resource, Connection } from '@foam/core';
+import { buildGraphData } from '@foam/core';
+import type { GraphData, NodeId, RootGroup } from '@foam/graph-view/protocol' with {
+  'resolution-mode': 'import',
+};
+import { classifyRoots, makeResourceNodeId } from './roots';
+
+export function buildRootQualifiedGraphData(
+  resources: Resource[],
+  connections: Connection[],
+  workspaceRoots: URI[]
+): { graphData: GraphData; idToUri: Map<NodeId, URI> } {
+  const classification = classifyRoots(workspaceRoots);
+  const builtGraphData = buildGraphData(resources, connections, {
+    resourceToId: uri => makeResourceNodeId(uri, classification.roots),
+    includePlaceholders: false,
+  });
+
+  const idToUri = new Map<NodeId, URI>();
+  for (const resource of resources) {
+    const id = makeResourceNodeId(resource.uri, classification.roots);
+    if (id !== undefined) {
+      idToUri.set(id, resource.uri);
+    }
+  }
+
+  const graphData: GraphData = {
+    ...builtGraphData,
+    rootGroups: classification.rootGroups,
+  };
+
+  return { graphData, idToUri };
+}

+import { describe, expect, it } from 'vitest';
+import { Range, URI, type Connection, type Resource } from '@foam/core';
+import { buildRootQualifiedGraphData } from './graph-data';
+import {
+  classifyRoots,
+  makeResourceNodeId,
+  resolveRoot,
+} from './roots';
+
+const vaultRoot = URI.file('/workspace');
+const sourcesRoot = URI.file('/sources');
+
+function makeResource(uri: URI, title = uri.getBasename()): Resource {
+  return {
+    uri,
+    type: 'note',
+    title,
+    properties: {},
+    sections: [],
+    blocks: [],
+    tags: [],
+    aliases: [],
+    links: [],
+    footnotes: [],
+  };
+}
+
+function makeConnection(source: URI, target: URI): Connection {
+  return {
+    source,
+    target,
+    link: {
+      type: 'wikilink',
+      rawText: '[[target]]',
+      range: Range.create(0, 0, 0, 0),
+      isEmbed: false,
+    },
+  };
+}
+
+describe('roots and graph data', () => {
+  it('test_roots_single_root_is_vault', () => {
+    expect(classifyRoots([vaultRoot])).toEqual({
+      roots: [{ uri: vaultRoot, kind: 'vault' }],
+      rootGroups: [
+        { root: 'vault', label: 'Vault', color: '#4a9eff' },
+      ],
+    });
+  });
+
+  it('test_roots_two_roots_first_vault_rest_sources', () => {
+    expect(classifyRoots([vaultRoot, sourcesRoot])).toEqual({
+      roots: [
+        { uri: vaultRoot, kind: 'vault' },
+        { uri: sourcesRoot, kind: 'sources' },
+      ],
+      rootGroups: [
+        { root: 'vault', label: 'Vault', color: '#4a9eff' },
+        { root: 'sources', label: 'Sources', color: '#ff9f43' },
+      ],
+    });
+  });
+
+  it('test_roots_resolveRoot_matches_first', () => {
+    const roots = classifyRoots([vaultRoot, vaultRoot.joinPath('nested')]).roots;
+    expect(resolveRoot(vaultRoot.joinPath('nested/note.md'), roots)).toBe(
+      roots[0]
+    );
+  });
+
+  it('test_roots_resolveRoot_no_match', () => {
+    const roots = classifyRoots([vaultRoot]).roots;
+    expect(resolveRoot(URI.file('/outside/note.md'), roots)).toBeUndefined();
+  });
+
+  it('test_roots_makeResourceNodeId_valid', () => {
+    const roots = classifyRoots([vaultRoot]).roots;
+    expect(makeResourceNodeId(vaultRoot.joinPath('notes/foo.md'), roots)).toBe(
+      'vault:notes/foo.md'
+    );

+import type { URI } from '@foam/core';
+import { relativeTo, isWithinPath } from '@foam/core';
+// @ts-expect-error The graph-view package publishes its runtime protocol as ESM while this package type-checks as CommonJS.
+import {
+  makeNodeId,
+  parseNodeId,
+  type NodeId,
+  type RootGroup,
+  type RootKind,
+} from '@foam/graph-view/protocol';
+
+export interface ClassifiedRoot {
+  uri: URI;
+  kind: RootKind;
+}
+
+export interface RootClassification {
+  roots: ClassifiedRoot[];
+  rootGroups: RootGroup[];
+}
+
+const ROOT_GROUPS: Record<RootKind, RootGroup> = {
+  vault: { root: 'vault', label: 'Vault', color: '#4a9eff' },
+  sources: { root: 'sources', label: 'Sources', color: '#ff9f43' },
+};
+
+export function classifyRoots(
+  workspaceRoots: URI[],
+  classification?: Map<URI, RootKind>
+): RootClassification {
+  const roots = workspaceRoots.map((uri, index): ClassifiedRoot => {
+    const mappedKind = classification?.get(uri) ??
+      [...(classification?.entries() ?? [])].find(([classifiedUri]) =>
+        classifiedUri.isEqual(uri)
+      )?.[1];
+    return {
+      uri,
+      kind: mappedKind ?? (index === 0 ? 'vault' : 'sources'),
+    };
+  });
+
+  const rootGroups = Array.from(new Set(roots.map(root => root.kind))).map(
+    kind => ({ ...ROOT_GROUPS[kind] })
+  );
+
+  return { roots, rootGroups };
+}
+
+export function resolveRoot(
+  uri: URI,
+  classifiedRoots: ClassifiedRoot[]
+): ClassifiedRoot | undefined {
+  return classifiedRoots.find(root => isWithinPath(uri, root.uri));
+}
+
+function isValidNodePath(path: string): boolean {
+  return parseNodeId(`vault:${path}`)?.path === path;
+}
+
+export function makeResourceNodeId(
+  uri: URI,
+  classifiedRoots: ClassifiedRoot[]
+): NodeId | undefined {
+  const root = resolveRoot(uri, classifiedRoots);
+  if (!root) {
+    return undefined;
+  }
+
+  const relativePath = relativeTo(uri.path, root.uri.path);
+  if (!isValidNodePath(relativePath)) {
+    return undefined;
+  }
+
+  return makeNodeId(root.kind, relativePath);
+}

index 0000000000000000000000000000000000000000..cbe4addcbe6eb18a312ceafdd1a128bd3b6c900b

+++ b/packages/foam-vscode/src/pa-hub/graph-data.ts
@@ -0,0 +1,34 @@
+import type { URI } from '@foam/core';
+import type { Resource, Connection } from '@foam/core';
+import { buildGraphData } from '@foam/core';
+import type { GraphData, NodeId, RootGroup } from '@foam/graph-view/protocol' with {
+  'resolution-mode': 'import',
+};
+import { classifyRoots, makeResourceNodeId } from './roots';
+
+export function buildRootQualifiedGraphData(
+  resources: Resource[],
+  connections: Connection[],
+  workspaceRoots: URI[]
+): { graphData: GraphData; idToUri: Map<NodeId, URI> } {
+  const classification = classifyRoots(workspaceRoots);
+  const builtGraphData = buildGraphData(resources, connections, {
+    resourceToId: uri => makeResourceNodeId(uri, classification.roots),
+    includePlaceholders: false,
+  });
+
+  const idToUri = new Map<NodeId, URI>();
+  for (const resource of resources) {
+    const id = makeResourceNodeId(resource.uri, classification.roots);
+    if (id !== undefined) {
+      idToUri.set(id, resource.uri);
+    }
+  }
+
+  const graphData: GraphData = {
+    ...builtGraphData,
+    rootGroups: classification.rootGroups,
+  };
+
+  return { graphData, idToUri };
+}

+import type { URI } from '@foam/core';
+import { relativeTo, isWithinPath } from '@foam/core';
+// @ts-expect-error The graph-view package publishes its runtime protocol as ESM while this package type-checks as CommonJS.
+import { makeNodeId, parseNodeId, type NodeId, type RootGroup, type RootKind } from '@foam/graph-view/protocol';
+
+export interface ClassifiedRoot {
+  uri: URI;
+  kind: RootKind;
+}
+
+export interface RootClassification {
+  roots: ClassifiedRoot[];
+  rootGroups: RootGroup[];
+}
+
+const ROOT_GROUPS: Record<RootKind, RootGroup> = {
+  vault: { root: 'vault', label: 'Vault', color: '#4a9eff' },
+  sources: { root: 'sources', label: 'Sources', color: '#ff9f43' },
+};
+
+export function classifyRoots(
+  workspaceRoots: URI[],
+  classification?: Map<URI, RootKind>
+): RootClassification {
+  const roots = workspaceRoots.map((uri, index): ClassifiedRoot => {
+    const mappedKind = classification?.get(uri) ??
+      [...(classification?.entries() ?? [])].find(([classifiedUri]) =>
+        classifiedUri.isEqual(uri)
+      )?.[1];
+    return {
+      uri,
+      kind: mappedKind ?? (index === 0 ? 'vault' : 'sources'),
+    };
+  });
+
+  const rootGroups = Array.from(new Set(roots.map(root => root.kind))).map(
+    kind => ({ ...ROOT_GROUPS[kind] })
+  );
+
+  return { roots, rootGroups };
+}
+
+export function resolveRoot(
+  uri: URI,
+  classifiedRoots: ClassifiedRoot[]
+): ClassifiedRoot | undefined {
+  return classifiedRoots.find(root => isWithinPath(uri, root.uri));
+}
+
+function isValidNodePath(path: string): boolean {
+  return parseNodeId(`vault:${path}`)?.path === path;
+}
+
+export function makeResourceNodeId(
+  uri: URI,
+  classifiedRoots: ClassifiedRoot[]
+): NodeId | undefined {
+  const root = resolveRoot(uri, classifiedRoots);
+  if (!root) {
+    return undefined;
+  }
+
+  const relativePath = relativeTo(uri.path, root.uri.path);
+  if (!isValidNodePath(relativePath)) {
+    return undefined;
+  }
+
+  return makeNodeId(root.kind, relativePath);
+}

diff --git a/packages/foam-vscode/src/pa-hub/graph-data.ts b/packages/foam-vscode/src/pa-hub/graph-data.ts
new file mode 100644
index 0000000000000000000000000000000000000000..cbe4addcbe6eb18a312ceafdd1a128bd3b6c900b

+++ b/packages/foam-vscode/src/pa-hub/graph-data.ts
@@ -0,0 +1,34 @@
+import type { URI } from '@foam/core';
+import type { Resource, Connection } from '@foam/core';
+import { buildGraphData } from '@foam/core';
+import type { GraphData, NodeId, RootGroup } from '@foam/graph-view/protocol' with {
+  'resolution-mode': 'import',
+};
+import { classifyRoots, makeResourceNodeId } from './roots';
+
+export function buildRootQualifiedGraphData(
+  resources: Resource[],
+  connections: Connection[],
+  workspaceRoots: URI[]
+): { graphData: GraphData; idToUri: Map<NodeId, URI> } {
+  const classification = classifyRoots(workspaceRoots);
+  const builtGraphData = buildGraphData(resources, connections, {
+    resourceToId: uri => makeResourceNodeId(uri, classification.roots),
+    includePlaceholders: false,
+  });
+
+  const idToUri = new Map<NodeId, URI>();
+  for (const resource of resources) {
+    const id = makeResourceNodeId(resource.uri, classification.roots);
+    if (id !== undefined) {
+      idToUri.set(id, resource.uri);
+    }
+  }
+
+  const graphData: GraphData = {
+    ...builtGraphData,
+    rootGroups: classification.rootGroups,
+  };
+
+  return { graphData, idToUri };
+}

+  resolveRoot,

+const vaultRoot = URI.file('/workspace');

+
+function makeResource(uri: URI, title = uri.getBasename()): Resource {
+  return {
+    uri,
+    type: 'note',
+    title,
+    properties: {},
+    sections: [],
+    blocks: [],
+    tags: [],
+    aliases: [],
+    links: [],
+    footnotes: [],
+  };
+}

+function makeConnection(source: URI, target: URI): Connection {
+  return {
+    source,
+    target,
+    link: {
+      type: 'wikilink',
+      rawText: '[[target]]',
+      range: Range.create(0, 0, 0, 0),
+      isEmbed: false,
+    },
+  };

+import type { URI } from '@foam/core';
+import { relativeTo, isWithinPath } from '@foam/core';
+// @ts-expect-error The graph-view package publishes its runtime protocol as ESM while this package type-checks as CommonJS.
+import { makeNodeId, parseNodeId, type NodeId, type RootGroup, type RootKind } from '@foam/graph-view/protocol';
+
+export interface ClassifiedRoot {
+  uri: URI;
+  kind: RootKind;
+}
+
+export interface RootClassification {
+  roots: ClassifiedRoot[];
+  rootGroups: RootGroup[];
+}
+
+const ROOT_GROUPS: Record<RootKind, RootGroup> = {
+  vault: { root: 'vault', label: 'Vault', color: '#4a9eff' },
+  sources: { root: 'sources', label: 'Sources', color: '#ff9f43' },
+};
+
+export function classifyRoots(
+  workspaceRoots: URI[],
+  classification?: Map<URI, RootKind>
+): RootClassification {
+  const roots = workspaceRoots.map((uri, index): ClassifiedRoot => {
+    const mappedKind = classification?.get(uri) ??
+      [...(classification?.entries() ?? [])].find(([classifiedUri]) =>
+        classifiedUri.isEqual(uri)
+      )?.[1];
+    return {
+      uri,
+      kind: mappedKind ?? (index === 0 ? 'vault' : 'sources'),
+    };
+  });
+
+  const rootGroups = Array.from(new Set(roots.map(root => root.kind))).map(
+    kind => ({ ...ROOT_GROUPS[kind] })
+  );
+
+  return { roots, rootGroups };
+}
+
+export function resolveRoot(
+  uri: URI,
+  classifiedRoots: ClassifiedRoot[]
+): ClassifiedRoot | undefined {
+  return classifiedRoots.find(root => isWithinPath(uri, root.uri));
+}
+
+function isValidNodePath(path: string): boolean {
+  return parseNodeId(`vault:${path}`)?.path === path;
+}
+
+export function makeResourceNodeId(
+  uri: URI,
+  classifiedRoots: ClassifiedRoot[]
+): NodeId | undefined {
+  const root = resolveRoot(uri, classifiedRoots);
+  if (!root) {
+    return undefined;
+  }
+
+  const relativePath = relativeTo(uri.path, root.uri.path);
+  if (!isValidNodePath(relativePath)) {
+    return undefined;
+  }
+
+  return makeNodeId(root.kind, relativePath);
+}

diff --git a/packages/foam-vscode/src/pa-hub/graph-data.ts b/packages/foam-vscode/src/pa-hub/graph-data.ts
new file mode 100644
index 0000000000000000000000000000000000000000..cbe4addcbe6eb18a312ceafdd1a128bd3b6c900b
--- /dev/null
+++ b/packages/foam-vscode/src/pa-hub/graph-data.ts
@@ -0,0 +1,34 @@
+import type { URI } from '@foam/core';
+import type { Resource, Connection } from '@foam/core';
+import { buildGraphData } from '@foam/core';
+import type { GraphData, NodeId, RootGroup } from '@foam/graph-view/protocol' with {
+  'resolution-mode': 'import',
+};
+import { classifyRoots, makeResourceNodeId } from './roots';
+
+export function buildRootQualifiedGraphData(
+  resources: Resource[],
+  connections: Connection[],
+  workspaceRoots: URI[]
+): { graphData: GraphData; idToUri: Map<NodeId, URI> } {
+  const classification = classifyRoots(workspaceRoots);
+  const builtGraphData = buildGraphData(resources, connections, {
+    resourceToId: uri => makeResourceNodeId(uri, classification.roots),
+    includePlaceholders: false,
+  });
+
+  const idToUri = new Map<NodeId, URI>();
+  for (const resource of resources) {
+    const id = makeResourceNodeId(resource.uri, classification.roots);
+    if (id !== undefined) {
+      idToUri.set(id, resource.uri);
+    }
+  }
+
+  const graphData: GraphData = {
+    ...builtGraphData,
+    rootGroups: classification.rootGroups,
+  };
+
+  return { graphData, idToUri };
+}

+import { describe, expect, it } from 'vitest';
+import { Range, URI, type Connection, type Resource } from '@foam/core';
+import { buildRootQualifiedGraphData } from './graph-data';
+import {
+  classifyRoots,
+  makeResourceNodeId,
+  resolveRoot,
+} from './roots';
+
+const vaultRoot = URI.file('/workspace');
+const sourcesRoot = URI.file('/sources');
+
+function makeResource(uri: URI, title = uri.getBasename()): Resource {
+  return {
+    uri,
+    type: 'note',
+    title,
+    properties: {},
+    sections: [],
+    blocks: [],
+    tags: [],
+    aliases: [],
+    links: [],
+    footnotes: [],
+  };
+}
+
+function makeConnection(source: URI, target: URI): Connection {
+  return {
+    source,
+    target,
+    link: {
+      type: 'wikilink',
+      rawText: '[[target]]',
+      range: Range.create(0, 0, 0, 0),
+      isEmbed: false,
+    },
+  };
+}
+
+describe('roots and graph data', () => {
+  it('test_roots_single_root_is_vault', () => {
+    expect(classifyRoots([vaultRoot])).toEqual({
+      roots: [{ uri: vaultRoot, kind: 'vault' }],
+      rootGroups: [
+        { root: 'vault', label: 'Vault', color: '#4a9eff' },
+      ],
+    });
+  });
+
+  it('test_roots_two_roots_first_vault_rest_sources', () => {
+    expect(classifyRoots([vaultRoot, sourcesRoot])).toEqual({
+      roots: [
+        { uri: vaultRoot, kind: 'vault' },
+        { uri: sourcesRoot, kind: 'sources' },
+      ],
+      rootGroups: [
+        { root: 'vault', label: 'Vault', color: '#4a9eff' },
+        { root: 'sources', label: 'Sources', color: '#ff9f43' },
+      ],
+    });
+  });
+
+  it('test_roots_resolveRoot_matches_first', () => {
+    const roots = classifyRoots([vaultRoot, vaultRoot.joinPath('nested')]).roots;
+    expect(resolveRoot(vaultRoot.joinPath('nested/note.md'), roots)).toBe(
+      roots[0]
+    );
+  });
+
+  it('test_roots_resolveRoot_no_match', () => {
+    const roots = classifyRoots([vaultRoot]).roots;
+    expect(resolveRoot(URI.file('/outside/note.md'), roots)).toBeUndefined();
+  });
+
+  it('test_roots_makeResourceNodeId_valid', () => {
+    const roots = classifyRoots([vaultRoot]).roots;
+    expect(makeResourceNodeId(vaultRoot.joinPath('notes/foo.md'), roots)).toBe(
+      'vault:notes/foo.md'
+    );
+  });
+
+  it('test_roots_makeResourceNodeId_outside_roots', () => {
+    const roots = classifyRoots([vaultRoot]).roots;
+    expect(() =>
+      makeResourceNodeId(URI.file('/outside/notes/foo.md'), roots)
+    ).not.toThrow();
+    expect(makeResourceNodeId(URI.file('/outside/notes/foo.md'), roots)).toBe(
+      undefined
+    );
+  });
+

+    const roots = classifyRoots([vaultRoot]).roots;
+    const invalidUri = URI.file('/workspace/notes/foo\u0000.md');
+    expect(() => makeResourceNodeId(invalidUri, roots)).not.toThrow(
+      RangeError
+    );
+    expect(makeResourceNodeId(invalidUri, roots)).toBeUndefined();
+  });

+    expect(serialized).not.toContain('/workspace');
+    expect(serialized).not.toContain('file:');
+  });

+import type { URI } from '@foam/core';
+import { relativeTo, isWithinPath } from '@foam/core';
+// @ts-expect-error The graph-view package publishes its runtime protocol as ESM while this package type-checks as CommonJS.
+import { makeNodeId, parseNodeId, type NodeId, type RootGroup, type RootKind } from '@foam/graph-view/protocol';
+
+export interface ClassifiedRoot {
+  uri: URI;
+  kind: RootKind;
+}
+
+export interface RootClassification {
+  roots: ClassifiedRoot[];
+  rootGroups: RootGroup[];
+}
+
+const ROOT_GROUPS: Record<RootKind, RootGroup> = {
+  vault: { root: 'vault', label: 'Vault', color: '#4a9eff' },
+  sources: { root: 'sources', label: 'Sources', color: '#ff9f43' },
+};
+
+export function classifyRoots(
+  workspaceRoots: URI[],
+  classification?: Map<URI, RootKind>
+): RootClassification {
+  const roots = workspaceRoots.map((uri, index): ClassifiedRoot => {
+    const mappedKind = classification?.get(uri) ??
+      [...(classification?.entries() ?? [])].find(([classifiedUri]) =>
+        classifiedUri.isEqual(uri)
+      )?.[1];
+    return {
+      uri,
+      kind: mappedKind ?? (index === 0 ? 'vault' : 'sources'),
+    };
+  });
+
+  const rootGroups = Array.from(new Set(roots.map(root => root.kind))).map(
+    kind => ({ ...ROOT_GROUPS[kind] })
+  );
+
+  return { roots, rootGroups };
+}
+
+export function resolveRoot(
+  uri: URI,
+  classifiedRoots: ClassifiedRoot[]
+): ClassifiedRoot | undefined {
+  return classifiedRoots.find(root => isWithinPath(uri, root.uri));
+}
+
+function isValidNodePath(path: string): boolean {
+  return parseNodeId(`vault:${path}`)?.path === path;
+}
+
+export function makeResourceNodeId(
+  uri: URI,
+  classifiedRoots: ClassifiedRoot[]
+): NodeId | undefined {
+  const root = resolveRoot(uri, classifiedRoots);
+  if (!root) {
+    return undefined;
+  }
+
+  const relativePath = relativeTo(uri.path, root.uri.path);
+  if (!isValidNodePath(relativePath)) {
+    return undefined;
+  }
+
+  return makeNodeId(root.kind, relativePath);
+}

diff --git a/packages/foam-vscode/src/pa-hub/graph-data.ts b/packages/foam-vscode/src/pa-hub/graph-data.ts
new file mode 100644
index 0000000000000000000000000000000000000000..cbe4addcbe6eb18a312ceafdd1a128bd3b6c900b
--- /dev/null
+++ b/packages/foam-vscode/src/pa-hub/graph-data.ts
@@ -0,0 +1,34 @@
+import type { URI } from '@foam/core';
+import type { Resource, Connection } from '@foam/core';
+import { buildGraphData } from '@foam/core';
+import type { GraphData, NodeId, RootGroup } from '@foam/graph-view/protocol' with {
+  'resolution-mode': 'import',
+};
+import { classifyRoots, makeResourceNodeId } from './roots';
+
+export function buildRootQualifiedGraphData(
+  resources: Resource[],
+  connections: Connection[],
+  workspaceRoots: URI[]
+): { graphData: GraphData; idToUri: Map<NodeId, URI> } {
+  const classification = classifyRoots(workspaceRoots);
+  const builtGraphData = buildGraphData(resources, connections, {
+    resourceToId: uri => makeResourceNodeId(uri, classification.roots),
+    includePlaceholders: false,
+  });
+
+  const idToUri = new Map<NodeId, URI>();
+  for (const resource of resources) {
+    const id = makeResourceNodeId(resource.uri, classification.roots);
+    if (id !== undefined) {
+      idToUri.set(id, resource.uri);
+    }
+  }
+
+  const graphData: GraphData = {
+    ...builtGraphData,
+    rootGroups: classification.rootGroups,
+  };
+
+  return { graphData, idToUri };
+}

+import { describe, expect, it } from 'vitest';
+import { Range, URI, type Connection, type Resource } from '@foam/core';
+import { buildRootQualifiedGraphData } from './graph-data';
+import {
+  classifyRoots,
+  makeResourceNodeId,
+  resolveRoot,
+} from './roots';
+
+const vaultRoot = URI.file('/workspace');
+const sourcesRoot = URI.file('/sources');
+
+function makeResource(uri: URI, title = uri.getBasename()): Resource {
+  return {
+    uri,
+    type: 'note',
+    title,
+    properties: {},
+    sections: [],
+    blocks: [],
+    tags: [],
+    aliases: [],
+    links: [],
+    footnotes: [],
+  };
+}
+
+function makeConnection(source: URI, target: URI): Connection {
+  return {
+    source,
+    target,
+    link: {
+      type: 'wikilink',
+      rawText: '[[target]]',
+      range: Range.create(0, 0, 0, 0),
+      isEmbed: false,
+    },
+  };
+}
+
+describe('roots and graph data', () => {
+  it('test_roots_single_root_is_vault', () => {
+    expect(classifyRoots([vaultRoot])).toEqual({
+      roots: [{ uri: vaultRoot, kind: 'vault' }],
+      rootGroups: [
+        { root: 'vault', label: 'Vault', color: '#4a9eff' },
+      ],
+    });
+  });
+
+  it('test_roots_two_roots_first_vault_rest_sources', () => {
+    expect(classifyRoots([vaultRoot, sourcesRoot])).toEqual({
+      roots: [
+        { uri: vaultRoot, kind: 'vault' },
+        { uri: sourcesRoot, kind: 'sources' },
+      ],
+      rootGroups: [
+        { root: 'vault', label: 'Vault', color: '#4a9eff' },
+        { root: 'sources', label: 'Sources', color: '#ff9f43' },
+      ],
+    });
+  });
+
+  it('test_roots_resolveRoot_matches_first', () => {
+    const roots = classifyRoots([vaultRoot, vaultRoot.joinPath('nested')]).roots;
+    expect(resolveRoot(vaultRoot.joinPath('nested/note.md'), roots)).toBe(
+      roots[0]
+    );
+  });
+
+  it('test_roots_resolveRoot_no_match', () => {
+    const roots = classifyRoots([vaultRoot]).roots;
+    expect(resolveRoot(URI.file('/outside/note.md'), roots)).toBeUndefined();
+  });
+
+  it('test_roots_makeResourceNodeId_valid', () => {
+    const roots = classifyRoots([vaultRoot]).roots;
+    expect(makeResourceNodeId(vaultRoot.joinPath('notes/foo.md'), roots)).toBe(
+      'vault:notes/foo.md'
+    );
+  });
+
+  it('test_roots_makeResourceNodeId_outside_roots', () => {
+    const roots = classifyRoots([vaultRoot]).roots;
+    expect(() =>
+      makeResourceNodeId(URI.file('/outside/notes/foo.md'), roots)
+    ).not.toThrow();
+    expect(makeResourceNodeId(URI.file('/outside/notes/foo.md'), roots)).toBe(
+      undefined
+    );
+  });
+
+  it('test_roots_makeResourceNodeId_invalid_path', () => {
+    const roots = classifyRoots([vaultRoot]).roots;
+    const invalidUri = URI.file('/workspace/notes/foo\u0000.md');
+    expect(() => makeResourceNodeId(invalidUri, roots)).not.toThrow(
+      RangeError
+    );
+    expect(makeResourceNodeId(invalidUri, roots)).toBeUndefined();
+  });
+
+  it('test_graph_data_no_absolute_paths', () => {
+    const note = makeResource(vaultRoot.joinPath('notes/foo.md'));
+    const graphData = buildRootQualifiedGraphData(
+      [note],
+      [],
+      [vaultRoot]
+    ).graphData;
+    const serialized = JSON.stringify(graphData);
+    expect(serialized).not.toContain('/workspace');
+    expect(serialized).not.toContain('file:');
+  });
+
+  it('test_graph_data_no_file_uri', () => {
+    const note = makeResource(vaultRoot.joinPath('notes/foo.md'));
+    const serialized = JSON.stringify(
+      buildRootQualifiedGraphData([note], [], [vaultRoot]).graphData
+    );
+    expect(serialized).not.toContain('file://');
+  });
+
+  it('test_graph_data_two_roots_correct_ids', () => {
+    const vaultNote = makeResource(vaultRoot.joinPath('notes/foo.md'));
+    const sourceNote = makeResource(sourcesRoot.joinPath('papers/foo.md'));
+    const { graphData } = buildRootQualifiedGraphData(
+      [vaultNote, sourceNote],
+      [makeConnection(vaultNote.uri, sourceNote.uri)],
+      [vaultRoot, sourcesRoot]
+    );
+    expect(Object.keys(graphData.nodeInfo)).toEqual([
+      'vault:notes/foo.md',
+      'sources:papers/foo.md',
+    ]);
+    expect(graphData.links).toEqual([
+      { source: 'vault:notes/foo.md', target: 'sources:papers/foo.md' },
+    ]);
+  });
+
+  it('test_graph_data_resource_outside_roots_excluded', () => {
+    const inside = makeResource(vaultRoot.joinPath('inside.md'));
+    const outside = makeResource(URI.file('/outside/outside.md'));
+    const { graphData } = buildRootQualifiedGraphData(
+      [inside, outside],
+      [makeConnection(inside.uri, outside.uri)],
+      [vaultRoot]
+    );
+    expect(graphData.nodeInfo['vault:inside.md']).toBeDefined();
+    expect(Object.values(graphData.nodeInfo)).not.toContainEqual(
+      expect.objectContaining({ title: 'outside.md' })
+    );
+    expect(graphData.links).toEqual([]);
+  });
+
+  it('test_graph_data_rootGroups_present', () => {
+    const { graphData } = buildRootQualifiedGraphData(
+      [],
+      [],
+      [vaultRoot, sourcesRoot]
+    );
+    expect(graphData.rootGroups).toEqual([
+      { root: 'vault', label: 'Vault', color: '#4a9eff' },
+      { root: 'sources', label: 'Sources', color: '#ff9f43' },
+    ]);
+  });
+
+  it('test_graph_data_idToUri_mapping', () => {
+    const note = makeResource(vaultRoot.joinPath('notes/foo.md'));
+    const { idToUri } = buildRootQualifiedGraphData(
+      [note],
+      [],
+      [vaultRoot]
+    );
+    expect(idToUri.get('vault:notes/foo.md')).toBe(note.uri);
+  });
+
+  it('test_graph_data_placeholders_excluded', () => {
+    const note = makeResource(vaultRoot.joinPath('notes/foo.md'));
+    const placeholder = URI.placeholder('missing.md');
+    const { graphData } = buildRootQualifiedGraphData(
+      [note],
+      [makeConnection(note.uri, placeholder)],
+      [vaultRoot]
+    );
+    expect(graphData.nodeInfo['missing.md']).toBeUndefined();
+    expect(graphData.links).toEqual([]);
+  });
+});

+import type { URI } from '@foam/core';
+import { relativeTo, isWithinPath } from '@foam/core';
+// @ts-expect-error The graph-view package publishes its runtime protocol as ESM while this package type-checks as CommonJS.
+import { makeNodeId, parseNodeId, type NodeId, type RootGroup, type RootKind } from '@foam/graph-view/protocol';
+
+export interface ClassifiedRoot {
+  uri: URI;
+  kind: RootKind;
+}
+
+export interface RootClassification {
+  roots: ClassifiedRoot[];
+  rootGroups: RootGroup[];
+}
+
+const ROOT_GROUPS: Record<RootKind, RootGroup> = {
+  vault: { root: 'vault', label: 'Vault', color: '#4a9eff' },
+  sources: { root: 'sources', label: 'Sources', color: '#ff9f43' },
+};
+
+export function classifyRoots(
+  workspaceRoots: URI[],
+  classification?: Map<URI, RootKind>
+): RootClassification {
+  const roots = workspaceRoots.map((uri, index): ClassifiedRoot => {
+    const mappedKind = classification?.get(uri) ??
+      [...(classification?.entries() ?? [])].find(([classifiedUri]) =>
+        classifiedUri.isEqual(uri)
+      )?.[1];
+    return {
+      uri,
+      kind: mappedKind ?? (index === 0 ? 'vault' : 'sources'),
+    };
+  });
+
+  const rootGroups = Array.from(new Set(roots.map(root => root.kind))).map(
+    kind => ({ ...ROOT_GROUPS[kind] })
+  );
+
+  return { roots, rootGroups };
+}
+
+export function resolveRoot(
+  uri: URI,
+  classifiedRoots: ClassifiedRoot[]
+): ClassifiedRoot | undefined {
+  return classifiedRoots.find(root => isWithinPath(uri, root.uri));
+}
+
+function isValidNodePath(path: string): boolean {
+  return parseNodeId(`vault:${path}`)?.path === path;
+}
+
+export function makeResourceNodeId(
+  uri: URI,
+  classifiedRoots: ClassifiedRoot[]
+): NodeId | undefined {
+  const root = resolveRoot(uri, classifiedRoots);
+  if (!root) {
+    return undefined;
+  }
+
+  const relativePath = relativeTo(uri.path, root.uri.path);
+  if (!isValidNodePath(relativePath)) {
+    return undefined;
+  }
+
+  return makeNodeId(root.kind, relativePath);
+}

+import type { URI } from '@foam/core';
+import type { Resource, Connection } from '@foam/core';
+import { buildGraphData } from '@foam/core';
+import type { GraphData, NodeId, RootGroup } from '@foam/graph-view/protocol' with {
+  'resolution-mode': 'import',
+};
+import { classifyRoots, makeResourceNodeId } from './roots';
+
+export function buildRootQualifiedGraphData(
+  resources: Resource[],
+  connections: Connection[],
+  workspaceRoots: URI[]
+): { graphData: GraphData; idToUri: Map<NodeId, URI> } {
+  const classification = classifyRoots(workspaceRoots);
+  const builtGraphData = buildGraphData(resources, connections, {
+    resourceToId: uri => makeResourceNodeId(uri, classification.roots),
+    includePlaceholders: false,
+  });
+
+  const idToUri = new Map<NodeId, URI>();
+  for (const resource of resources) {
+    const id = makeResourceNodeId(resource.uri, classification.roots);
+    if (id !== undefined) {
+      idToUri.set(id, resource.uri);
+    }
+  }
+
+  const graphData: GraphData = {
+    ...builtGraphData,
+    rootGroups: classification.rootGroups,
+  };
+
+  return { graphData, idToUri };
+}

+function makeResource(uri: URI, title = uri.getBasename()): Resource {
+  return {
+    uri,
+    type: 'note',
+    title,
+    properties: {},
+    sections: [],
+    blocks: [],
+    tags: [],
+    aliases: [],
+    links: [],
+    footnotes: [],
+  };
+}

+function makeConnection(source: URI, target: URI): Connection {
+  return {
+    source,
+    target,
+    link: {
+      type: 'wikilink',
+      rawText: '[[target]]',
+      range: Range.create(0, 0, 0, 0),
+      isEmbed: false,
+    },
+  };

// @ts-expect-error The graph-view package publishes its runtime protocol as ESM while this package type-checks as CommonJS.
import {
  makeNodeId,
  parseNodeId,
  type NodeId,
  type RootGroup,
  type RootKind,
} from '@foam/graph-view/protocol';

export interface ClassifiedRoot {
  uri: URI;
  kind: RootKind;
}

export interface RootClassification {
  roots: ClassifiedRoot[];
  rootGroups: RootGroup[];
}

const ROOT_GROUPS: Record<RootKind, RootGroup> = {
  vault: { root: 'vault', label: 'Vault', color: '#4a9eff' },
  sources: { root: 'sources', label: 'Sources', color: '#ff9f43' },
};

export function classifyRoots(
  workspaceRoots: URI[],
  classification?: Map<URI, RootKind>
): RootClassification {
  const roots = workspaceRoots.map((uri, index): ClassifiedRoot => {
    const mappedKind =
      classification?.get(uri) ??
      [...(classification?.entries() ?? [])].find(([classifiedUri]) =>
        classifiedUri.isEqual(uri)
      )?.[1];
    return {
      uri,
      kind: mappedKind ?? (index === 0 ? 'vault' : 'sources'),
    };
  });

  const rootGroups = Array.from(new Set(roots.map(root => root.kind))).map(
    kind => ({ ...ROOT_GROUPS[kind] })
  );

  return { roots, rootGroups };
}

export function resolveRoot(
  uri: URI,
  classifiedRoots: ClassifiedRoot[]
): ClassifiedRoot | undefined {
  return classifiedRoots.find(root => isWithinPath(uri, root.uri));
}

function isValidNodePath(path: string): boolean {
  return parseNodeId(`vault:${path}`)?.path === path;
}

export function makeResourceNodeId(
  uri: URI,
  classifiedRoots: ClassifiedRoot[]
): NodeId | undefined {
  const root = resolveRoot(uri, classifiedRoots);
  if (!root) {
    return undefined;
  }

  const relativePath = relativeTo(uri.path, root.uri.path);
  if (!isValidNodePath(relativePath)) {
    return undefined;
  }

  return makeNodeId(root.kind, relativePath);
}

  workspaceRoots: URI[]

+import type { URI } from '@foam/core';
+import { relativeTo, isWithinPath } from '@foam/core';
+// @ts-expect-error The graph-view package publishes its runtime protocol as ESM while this package type-checks as CommonJS.
+import { makeNodeId, parseNodeId, type NodeId, type RootGroup, type RootKind } from '@foam/graph-view/protocol';
+
+export interface ClassifiedRoot {
+  uri: URI;
+  kind: RootKind;
+}
+
+export interface RootClassification {
+  roots: ClassifiedRoot[];
+  rootGroups: RootGroup[];
+}
+
+const ROOT_GROUPS: Record<RootKind, RootGroup> = {
+  vault: { root: 'vault', label: 'Vault', color: '#4a9eff' },
+  sources: { root: 'sources', label: 'Sources', color: '#ff9f43' },
+};
+
+export function classifyRoots(
+  workspaceRoots: URI[],
+  classification?: Map<URI, RootKind>
+): RootClassification {
+  const roots = workspaceRoots.map((uri, index): ClassifiedRoot => {
+    const mappedKind = classification?.get(uri) ??
+      [...(classification?.entries() ?? [])].find(([classifiedUri]) =>
+        classifiedUri.isEqual(uri)
+      )?.[1];
+    return {
+      uri,
+      kind: mappedKind ?? (index === 0 ? 'vault' : 'sources'),
+    };
+  });
+
+  const rootGroups = Array.from(new Set(roots.map(root => root.kind))).map(
+    kind => ({ ...ROOT_GROUPS[kind] })
+  );
+
+  return { roots, rootGroups };
+}
+
+export function resolveRoot(
+  uri: URI,
+  classifiedRoots: ClassifiedRoot[]
+): ClassifiedRoot | undefined {
+  return classifiedRoots.find(root => isWithinPath(uri, root.uri));
+}
+
+function isValidNodePath(path: string): boolean {
+  return parseNodeId(`vault:${path}`)?.path === path;
+}
+
+export function makeResourceNodeId(
+  uri: URI,
+  classifiedRoots: ClassifiedRoot[]
+): NodeId | undefined {
+  const root = resolveRoot(uri, classifiedRoots);
+  if (!root) {
+    return undefined;
+  }
+
+  const relativePath = relativeTo(uri.path, root.uri.path);
+  if (!isValidNodePath(relativePath)) {
+    return undefined;
+  }
+
+  return makeNodeId(root.kind, relativePath);
+}

diff --git a/packages/foam-vscode/src/pa-hub/graph-data.ts b/packages/foam-vscode/src/pa-hub/graph-data.ts
new file mode 100644
index 0000000000000000000000000000000000000000..cbe4addcbe6eb18a312ceafdd1a128bd3b6c900b
--- /dev/null
+++ b/packages/foam-vscode/src/pa-hub/graph-data.ts
@@ -0,0 +1,34 @@
+import type { URI } from '@foam/core';
+import type { Resource, Connection } from '@foam/core';
+import { buildGraphData } from '@foam/core';
+import type { GraphData, NodeId, RootGroup } from '@foam/graph-view/protocol' with {
+  'resolution-mode': 'import',
+};
+import { classifyRoots, makeResourceNodeId } from './roots';
+
+export function buildRootQualifiedGraphData(
+  resources: Resource[],
+  connections: Connection[],
+  workspaceRoots: URI[]
+): { graphData: GraphData; idToUri: Map<NodeId, URI> } {
+  const classification = classifyRoots(workspaceRoots);
+  const builtGraphData = buildGraphData(resources, connections, {
+    resourceToId: uri => makeResourceNodeId(uri, classification.roots),
+    includePlaceholders: false,
+  });
+
+  const idToUri = new Map<NodeId, URI>();
+  for (const resource of resources) {
+    const id = makeResourceNodeId(resource.uri, classification.roots);
+    if (id !== undefined) {
+      idToUri.set(id, resource.uri);
+    }
+  }
+
+  const graphData: GraphData = {
+    ...builtGraphData,
+    rootGroups: classification.rootGroups,
+  };
+
+  return { graphData, idToUri };
+}

+    expect(makeResourceNodeId(URI.file('/outside/notes/foo.md'), roots)).toBe(
+      undefined
+    );
+  });
+
+  it('test_roots_makeResourceNodeId_invalid_path', () => {
+    const roots = classifyRoots([vaultRoot]).roots;
+    const invalidUri = URI.file('/workspace/notes/foo\u0000.md');
+    expect(() => makeResourceNodeId(invalidUri, roots)).not.toThrow(
+      RangeError
+    );
+    expect(makeResourceNodeId(invalidUri, roots)).toBeUndefined();
+  });
+
+  it('test_graph_data_no_absolute_paths', () => {
+    const note = makeResource(vaultRoot.joinPath('notes/foo.md'));
+    const graphData = buildRootQualifiedGraphData(
+      [note],
+      [],
+      [vaultRoot]
+    ).graphData;
+    const serialized = JSON.stringify(graphData);
+    expect(serialized).not.toContain('/workspace');
+    expect(serialized).not.toContain('file:');
+  });
+
+  it('test_graph_data_no_file_uri', () => {
+    const note = makeResource(vaultRoot.joinPath('notes/foo.md'));
+    const serialized = JSON.stringify(
+      buildRootQualifiedGraphData([note], [], [vaultRoot]).graphData
+    );
+    expect(serialized).not.toContain('file://');
+  });
+
+  it('test_graph_data_two_roots_correct_ids', () => {
+    const vaultNote = makeResource(vaultRoot.joinPath('notes/foo.md'));
+    const sourceNote = makeResource(sourcesRoot.joinPath('papers/foo.md'));
+    const { graphData } = buildRootQualifiedGraphData(
+      [vaultNote, sourceNote],
+      [makeConnection(vaultNote.uri, sourceNote.uri)],
+      [vaultRoot, sourcesRoot]
+    );
+    expect(Object.keys(graphData.nodeInfo)).toEqual([
+      'vault:notes/foo.md',
+      'sources:papers/foo.md',
+    ]);
+    expect(graphData.links).toEqual([
+      { source: 'vault:notes/foo.md', target: 'sources:papers/foo.md' },
+    ]);
+  });
+
+  it('test_graph_data_resource_outside_roots_excluded', () => {
+    const inside = makeResource(vaultRoot.joinPath('inside.md'));
+    const outside = makeResource(URI.file('/outside/outside.md'));

+    expect(Object.values(graphData.nodeInfo)).not.toContainEqual(

+    );
+    expect(graphData.links).toEqual([]);
+  });

+      [],
+      [],

+      { root: 'vault', label: 'Vault', color: '#4a9eff' },
+      { root: 'sources', label: 'Sources', color: '#ff9f43' },
+    ]);
+  });
